display_name: Snapdeal query pattern — 10.1 OMS ↔ Settlement Matching
name: Snapdeal query pattern — 10.1 OMS ↔ Settlement Matching
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  o.invoice_number,
  o.charged_amount AS oms_gmv,
  s.settled_amount AS settlement_net,
  CASE WHEN s.invoice_number IS NULL THEN 'Not in Settlement' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.current_order_state = 'Delivered';

name: Snapdeal query pattern — 10.2 Payments ↔ Settlement Matching
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  p.utr_no_,
  p.gross_amount AS payment_received,
  SUM(s.settled_amount) AS sum_of_settlement_lines,
  p.gross_amount - SUM(s.settled_amount) AS variance
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_payments p
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE p.is_active = true
GROUP BY p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount;

name: Snapdeal query pattern — 10.3 Commission Validation

sql_template:

FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON c.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE c.is_active = true;

name: Snapdeal query pattern — 8.1 Full Settlement Financial Summary

  ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';

SELECT
  CAST(tax_igst_rate AS VARCHAR) AS igst_rate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,

FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY tax_igst_rate
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

SELECT
  courier_partner,
  COUNT(*) AS shipments,
  COUNT_IF(current_order_state = 'Delivered') AS delivered,
  COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'reverse') AS returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(current_order_state = 'Delivered') / COUNT(*), 2) AS delivery_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
WHERE is_active = true

ORDER BY shipments DESC;
